text:
sam: noticed ALB target group in eu-west-1 showing a spike in 5xx + several targets marked unused at ~11:02UTC. health checks returning 503s.
jordana: same here, targets flip to unused within 8-12s although pods show Ready=true.
ravi: any infra deploys around that time? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: deploy finished: egress-gateway v2 -> eu-west-1 at 11:01:48 UTC :white_check_mark:
eng-oncall: grabbed packet capture from node servicing the target. LB probe arrives then our node returns RST to LB probe IP within a few ms.
sam: curling the pod IP:readiness-port from the node keeps succeeding locally.
natalie: tcpdump excerpt from node:
```
11:02:58.987654 IP 35.176.23.45.443 > 10.0.24.88.49160: Flags [P.], seq 123:640, ack 1, win 501
11:02:58.987921 IP 10.0.24.88.49160 > 52.50.110.12.443: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0
```
ravi: RST out to 52.50.110.12 (alb probe) is coming from a gateway address (10.1.5.9) per conntrack. looks like reply is SNAT'd through egress-gateway.
jordana: oh — egress-gateway v2 added a MASQUERADE rule in its namespace during the rollout. LB expects probes to come from the node IP, not gateway SNAT. ALB marks mismatch as failed.
eng-oncall: conntrack stats on node:
```
# conntrack -S
entries 4820
found 4708
searched 34210
```
eng-oncall: ephemeral port usage is high, `ss -s` shows many TIME_WAITs.
sam: quick mitigation options?
natalie: either roll back the egress-gateway, or add an exception to bypass SNAT for the ALB probe CIDRs, or add hostNetwork to gateway pods for probe paths.
ravi: reproduced by arti: when I send a probe from LB to node -> pod, the pod's reply goes out via gateway IP because of the namespace MASQUERADE chain.
sam: let's try a targeted bypass for known ALB healthcheck CIDRs in eu-west-1 first (short mitigation). jordana — can you patch egress policy to exclude 52.50.0.0/16 and 35.176.0.0/16? (example ranges)
jordana: applying iptables bypass now, will pin to nodes with targets only.
eng-oncall: making change, syncing iptables — give it 20s.
jordana: change applied. re-checking ALB target health — still some flapping but trending healthy.
sam: I'll mute alerts for target-group for 20m while we watch.
ravi: follow-ups: create infra ticket to change gateway behavior: either preserve-source for node->pod replies, or route LB probe replies out via node IP, or run gateway with hostNetwork when handling probe-matching flows.
natalie: also logging ephemeral port pressure: filing infra-3802 to expand net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range on busy nodes and tune TIME_WAIT recycling.
sam: created infra-3147 to address gateway SNAT behavior and rollout guardrails. mark as P1 for next sprint.
eng-oncall: if bypass expires and issues return we'll trigger rollback of egress-gateway v2.
sam: thanks all, keep posting quick updates here. :pray:
